adds.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia)
adds.summary: Fetched (HTTP 200, cached). Article's Brazil content documents only the right to same-sex-partner conjugal visitations in all Brazilian jails from February 2015, per the National Criminal and Penitentiary Council; it contains no Pernambuco-specific trans-prisoner placement rule, special unit, segregation practice, or documented case. Establishs that the general enwiki source does not fill the state-level placement gap.

adds.title: LGBTQ rights in Brazil (Wikipedia)
adds.summary: Fetched (HTTP 200, cached). Documents the national framework governing trans prisoners that applies uniformly across Brazilian states including Pernambuco: LGBTQ people have a special, separate place in Brazilian prisons; transsexuals have the right to be addressed by their social name rather than birth name; to be forwarded to women's prisons (i.e. placement by gender identity); and to choose male or female clothing. No state-level/state-DOC (Secretaria de Administração Penitenciária e Ressocialização de Pernambuco) placement detail is given.

records.note: No Pernambuco-specific trans prisoner-housing placement data was found within budget (1 Wikipedia full-text search; 2 candidate fetches, one of which - Penal Reform International LGBTI-inmates page - 404'd at fetch time). The single enwiki full-text search surfaced no state-level placement content; the two enwiki fetches show only the uniform national framework: LGBTQ prisoners have a separate space in Brazilian prisons, transsexuals may use their social name, are forwarded to women's prisons by gender identity, and choose their clothing (CNJ-linked policy documented on enwiki 'LGBTQ rights in Brazil'). No Pernambuco DOC placement rule, special unit, or documented trans-prisoner housing case surfaced in audited sources within budget; the national framework applies uniformly.
